Required purchased-body / insert-loading depth transition. These 0.850 mm face strips join the 4.30 mm-high body/ear stadium and the 2.60 mm-high knurl-loading stadium, each with the separate supported-face allowance, at body-cavity end Y86.790. The source retains 3.10 mm axial root allowance between body depth 4.15 and heat-set anchor 7.25. Exact native rejection witnesses show that extending the body cavity to the anchor removes both 3.10 mm material lines and opens cavity points only 1.427773 mm from the nominal Ø2.3 knurls, below the specified 3 mm root. The strip width is not a 0.850 mm through-wall allowance. Printed loading and screw retention remain separately unqualified.
